warnings: This is the pile-footing alternate of หน้า67_view1 -- same item list shape (concrete/rebar/formwork/plank), but the pile spec item (เสาเข็ม ø0.15m x 6.00m, 117 ต้น) replaces spread footing's larger concrete volume. Rebar/concrete/formwork totals are higher here than the spread-footing version (e.g. concrete 38 vs 40 ลบ.ม. -- close but not identical, consistent with the two systems needing genuinely different quantities per S-01's design note.

Categories 2-5 (หน้า80 onward) are expected to be IDENTICAL in content to the spread-footing BOQ's categories 2-5, since architecture/sanitary/electrical/misc work does not depend on which foundation system is used -- to be confirmed page-by-page rather than assumed.
